# Copper Wren Movement Studio: 2029 Missed Class and Credit Policy

An ordinary absence reported at least 17 hours before class may qualify for one replacement class credit.
A replacement class credit expires 60 calendar days after the missed class.
A credit cannot be converted to cash or applied to the spring lab.
A teacher must confirm a replacement place before the booking changes.
An absence form records a request, not a confirmed replacement booking.
Illness absences reported after class require teacher review and have no automatic credit.
